events.summary: Teferi phases out the Unyaro Plains and Jungle with northwestern Jamuraa to spare it the Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: The Unyaro Plains and Jungle were phased out, alongside the rest of northwestern Jamuraa , by Teferi

events.summary: Jeska destroys the time rift over the Zhalfirin Void, forever losing the plains from Dominaria.
events.quote: It was forever lost from Dominaria after Jeska destroyed the time rift over the Zhalfirin Void.

events.summary: After the New Phyrexian Invasion, Wrenn and Realmbreaker return Zhalfir to the multiverse by swapping it with New Phyrexia.
events.quote: Wrenn and Realmbreaker returned the phased out Zhalfir to the multiverse
